title: Slack App-level token: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one character inside the second section replaced with '!', outside every cited alphabet; widths unchanged, alphabet: one character of the all-digit third section replaced with the letter Q (every cited source and provider placeholder gives that section as digits; widths unchanged), and alphabet: the separator between the second and third sections is '_' instead of '-' (no cited source puts '_' in an xapp- value; widths unchanged). Twin of "Slack App-level token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of slack-app-level-token-agent-yaml: alphabet: one character inside the second section replaced with '!', outside every cited alphabet; widths unchanged. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
